item.title: Strait of Hormuz traffic falls to new low as Iran-backed group kills 6 in Red Sea
item.description: The conflict between the U.S. and Iran has spread to the Red Sea and another strategic shipping route.

item.title: David Crowley beats progressive Francesca Hong in Wisconsin gubernatorial primary
item.description: David Crowley unexpectedly beat a progressive candidate in the Democratic primary for Wisconsin governor, and will face Republican Rep. Tom Tiffany on the ballot in November.

item.title: $1 billion Powerball jackpot on the line in tonight's drawing. Here's what to know.
item.description: The jackpot is the eighth-largest Powerball prize ever.

item.title: What to know about today's total solar eclipse
item.description: The only total solar eclipse of 2026 will cross the Northern Hemisphere on Wednesday, Aug. 12, with a path of totality across parts of Greenland, Iceland and northern Spain. See when and where it will be visible.

item.title: American tourists flock to Europe to experience 2026's only total solar eclipse
item.description: A small part of the U.S. will be able to see a sliver of partial solar eclipse, but the path of totality will cut through Europe. CBS News meteorologist Rob Marciano has more from Mallorca, Spain.

item.title: Trump speaks out on secret Air Force One plane switch after Iran's missile threat
item.description: President Trump is responding to questions after the Secret Service addressed a threat from Iran by covertly moving him to a second plane when leaving Turkey a month ago. "I just have to do what they say," he said. Some aides and journalists were left on board the decoy plane. CBS News' Nancy Cordes has more.

item.title: Becky G opens up about carrying "resentment," pressure as a child to be family's breadwinner
item.description: "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King speaks exclusively with pop superstar Becky G about feeling the pressure of becoming her family's breadwinner at a young age.

item.title: Police race to save murder evidence from being turned into scrap metal
item.description: Police say the driver of the minivan — who wore a mask, glasses and a hard hat — sprayed security cameras with blue paint to hide his crime inside an Oregon parking garage.

item.title: CPI report shows inflation eased in July to a 3.4% annual pace
item.description: The CPI report was in line with economists' expectations, marking the second consecutive month with cooler price pressures.

item.title: Sneak peek: Murder in the Parking Garage
item.description: ENCORE: A masked killer spray paints security cameras to hide his crime. "48 Hours" correspondent Natalie Morales reports Saturday, August 15 at 10/9c on CBS and streaming on Paramount+.

item.title: Why some people can't relax while on vacation
item.description: CBS News contributor Arthur C. Brooks talks about the science and history of relaxation while on vacation and why doing nothing comes easier for some people.

item.title: Rubio, Bessent took decoy Air Force One, Hegseth flew on secret flight with Trump
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent were on the decoy flight last month when President Trump secretly switched to a different plane while Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was with Mr. Trump.

item.title: Baby rescued from earthquake rubble in Colombia as death toll rises
item.description: Footage shared on social media shows a baby being rescued from the bloody arms of a man trapped underneath a destroyed building in Cali after a powerful earthquake struck Colombia.

item.title: What David Crowley's projected win in Wisconsin primary means for Democrats
item.description: Results in key Democratic primaries are providing more insight into the potential future of the Democratic Party as progressives and moderates battle for nominations. CBS News' Taurean Small reports, and political strategist Alex Vogel and Hyma Moore share their reactions.

item.title: What are today's mortgage and mortgage refinance interest rates?
item.description: Knowing today's mortgage rates can help new homebuyers and homeowners looking to lock in a good deal.

item.title: Inside look at air traffic control upgrades amid aging system
item.description: The U.S. Department of Transportation is spending more than $12 billion to upgrade air traffic control operations nationwide. Kris Van Cleave spoke with Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy about the upgrades and got new details regarding an incident involving Marine One.

item.title: Judge in Mangione case rules jury in state trial will be anonymous
item.description: At a hearing for Luigi Mangione, who is accused of killing UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, a judge ruled the jury in Mangione's New York state murder trial will be anonymous. Tom Hanson explains.

item.title: Powerball jackpot hits $1 billion after no one won $905 million grand prize
item.description: No winning tickets were sold for Monday night's $905 million Powerball jackpot, so the estimated grand prize for Wednesday's drawing will be at least $1 billion.

item.title: See how the Secret Service is cracking down on card-skimming scams
item.description: Scams involving credit card skimmers are on the rise, according to the U.S. Secret Service, costing consumers more than $1 billion each year. Since 2024, the Secret Service has removed what it says is just a fraction of the devices nationwide. Carter Evans reports.

item.title: Lisa Demuth tops Mike Lindell in GOP primary for Minnesota governor
item.description: Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth will win the Republican primary in Minnesota's gubernatorial race, CBS News projects.

item.title: What to know about 2026's only total solar eclipse
item.description: CBS News meteorologist Rob Marciano explains what to know about the only solar eclipse happening this year. Parts of Europe will experience totality, while some U.S. states will see a partial eclipse.

item.title: Powerball jackpot grows to $1 billion, the biggest lottery prize of the year so far
item.description: The Powerball jackpot Wednesday has risen to $1 billion. The last person to win the jackpot was in May. Jason Allen reports.

item.title: U.S. Marine veteran freed from Russian prison after nearly 4 years
item.description: A U.S. Marine veteran from Massachusetts who has been held in Russia for more than four years on disputed charges has been released.

item.title: Son of Myanmar's Aung San Suu Kyi reacts to first photos since her arrest after 2021 coup
item.description: Myanmar's former leader Aung San Suu Kyi has been in detention since a 2021 military coup. She was seen in photos for the first time since the coup after meeting with a delegation from the International Committee of the Red Cross. Her son, Kim Aris, spoke with CBS News' Ramy Inocencio.

item.title: U.S. Marine veteran freed from prison in Russia after 4 years
item.description: Robert Gilman, a U.S. Marine veteran, was released from a Russian prison after more than four years. He had been reported to be in failing health. Leigh Kiniry reports.

item.title: Trump faces questions about staff, journalists left aboard Air Force One facing deadly Iran threat
item.description: President Trump was covertly moved to a second plane when leaving the NATO summit in Turkey after a missile threat from Iran. Lawmakers now have questions about the staffers and journalists left on board the decoy plane. CBS News' Aaron Navarro reports.

item.title: See the moment a woman was pulled from debris following devastating Colombia earthquake
item.description: The search for survivors continues in Colombia after a powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake struck earlier this week. The country's president says more than 180 people have been killed and thousands are injured. Lilia Luciano has the latest.

item.title: How the Secret Service is cracking down on card-skimming scams
item.description: A Secret Service analyst told CBS News a single skimming device can net a scammer up to $1 million.

item.title: ICE plans to give officers gloves that can deliver electric shocks
item.description: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers may soon be outfitted with gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks that are intended to gain compliance from combative individuals.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's psychiatrist completes testimony with tense exchange
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's first psychiatrist completed her testimony with a tense exchange with Clancy's attorney.
